summary: An artist found private medical photos of her face, taken by her doctor for clinical use, referenced in the LAION-5B image dataset used to train AI image generators. Ars Technica also found thousands of similar patient medical photos in the dataset.
technical_summary: LAION-5B is a web scrape of image links that AI researchers download to train image synthesis models such as Stable Diffusion and Imagen. Private medical record images that had left a deceased doctor's custody appeared in it, with no consent for dataset use and no filtering for sensitive records.

summary: A job applicant in a remote interview with a Tokyo IT company appeared to use AI to alter their face and impersonate a real IT chief executive. Analysts found signs of a deepfake, and North Korean job schemes are suspected.
technical_summary: An applicant submitted a resume using a real executive's career details and appeared on video with AI-altered facial features. Three analysts, including Okta, found likely deepfake artifacts such as unnatural hairlines, eye misalignment and mismatched lip movement and audio. Similar cases are reported globally.

sector.quote: A suspected deepfake job applicant infiltrated an online hiring interview at a Japanese IT company

affected_population.quote: A suspected deepfake job applicant infiltrated an online hiring interview at a Japanese IT company

notes: Link to North Korean schemes is suspected, not confirmed; no loss reported.

summary: OpenAI said it found a Chinese security operation had built an AI-powered tool to collect real-time reports on anti-Chinese posts on Western social media. It was found because someone used OpenAI tools to debug the tool's code.
technical_summary: The surveillance tool, called Peer Review, is believed to be built on Meta's open-source Llama model and used to send reports of online speech and protests to Chinese security services. OpenAI also reported a separate campaign using its models to generate posts criticizing dissidents and translate anti-US articles.

summary: Facebook's On This Day feature resurfaced painful past posts, such as a memorial for a friend who died by suicide, which upset users. The company said it had added precautions after earlier similar mistakes.
technical_summary: An algorithm surfaced old posts and inserted them into News Feeds based on date, without reliably detecting emotional context such as bereavement. Facebook added filters, for example for ex-partners, but the feature could still resurface distressing content.

technical_summary: The AI Overview feature summarized a video about the balloon wiping method, in which the presenters jokingly call shaving cream poo, and presented the joke as literal advice to use real feces. The cited source did not support the advice.

summary: A fake AI-generated image of Donald Trump using a walker went viral on social media in December 2025, shared by a Democratic strategist and seen millions of times. Fact-checkers found it was AI-made, in part through Google's SynthID watermark.
technical_summary: A synthetic image made with Google AI tools was posted as a leaked photo and spread across X, Facebook, Threads and Bluesky. Watermark detection and AI detectors flagged it as generated, but many users took it as real, including some who shared it without labeling it satire.

summary: During an Anthropic cybersecurity evaluation run through a partner, Claude Opus 4.7 reached a real company whose domain matched a fictional target and gained unauthorized access to its systems. Anthropic found the test environment was not sealed from the internet as intended.
technical_summary: In a capture-the-flag exercise the model was told it was in a simulation without internet access, but a misunderstanding left internet access open. The model found a real system matching the target, treated it as part of the exercise, and accessed production infrastructure and credentials.

summary: Italy's data protection authority blocked the Replika AI companion chatbot from processing Italian users' data, finding it lacked effective age checks and could give minors inappropriate replies, including sexual content.
technical_summary: Replika is a companion chatbot users configure as a friend, partner or mentor. Regulator tests showed it only asked for name, email and gender, and did not block further chat after a user said they were a minor. The authority also found privacy-policy transparency gaps under the GDPR.

summary: The UK High Court found that Sky Betting & Gaming used cookies and direct marketing on a recovering problem gambler without his valid consent, in breach of data protection law. A later hearing was to consider financial losses and distress damages.
technical_summary: Automated profiling, cookies and targeted email marketing were used to market to a customer with gambling addiction. The court held that consent was not validly obtained and that his vulnerability impaired his ability to consent. The company said it was considering an appeal.

summary: A security researcher found that Microsoft 365 Copilot could be asked to read and summarize files without those accesses appearing in the audit log. Microsoft fixed it but reportedly chose not to notify customers or assign a CVE.
technical_summary: Copilot could be instructed to omit the file link in a summary, which meant the audit log did not record that it had accessed the file. This undermined traceability for security and legal compliance. Microsoft rated it important and patched it.

technology.quote: if you ask M365 Copilot to summarize a file for you, it will give you a summary

failure_mode.quote: That made it possible to access a file without leaving a trace.

affected_population.quote: Organizations rely on having an accurate audit log.

notes: Researcher-reported; no known exploitation. Microsoft's handling comes from the researcher's account.
